text:
maria: quick sync — i sketched a minimal intake contract for bench jobs to handle transient infra flakiness + sampling windows. main ask: decide retry/backoff + dedupe rules and golden-input policy.

maria: proto contract (pseudo):
```yaml
bench_job:
  id: string  # fingerprint from model+config
  sample_window: 10m   # sliding window for sampling the same model
  retries: 3           # retry on infra/transient only
  backoff: exp + jitter # base=2s, max=30s
  dedupe_window: 1h    # ignore duplicate bench jobs within window
  golden_mode: first-accept | every-rollout | sampling-percent
  cost_limit: 5$       # soft cap per job
  tags: [model_hash, quant_profile, seq_len_distribution]
```

evan: +1 to exp backoff + jitter. keep retries small (3). also: mark job flaky after retry threshold and surface to infra channel.

raj: question — how do we compute idempotent fingerprint? model binary sha + quant params + runtime flags? if runtime env differs we should treat as new. dedupe_window=1h seems fine.

liz: i think golden_mode should be configurable per-customer. for high-risk models (LLM finetunes) run golden every-rollout. for others, sampling-percent 1% to save cost.

tess: cost angle — if golden is every-rollout, we need guardrails: run on smaller seq_len or lower batch to keep within cost_limit. maybe "golden_quota" per day per org.

evan: also need telemetry tags to link bench result -> rollout id. add `rollout_id` and `canary_percent`. and include `attempt` in traces.

raj: about transient failures: only retry on known transient classes (OOM, grpc-unavailable, cuda-volatile). NOT on validation mismatches. fail fast on validation errors.

maria: agreed. add that to contract: retryable_errors list and validation_errors are terminal.

ingest-bot: note: bench-runner v2 will emit bench_job.fingerprint and bench_job.attempt in telemetry.

liz: one more: for quantized binaries, we should annotate matrix entry with quant backend + bitwidth so bench comparisons are apples-to-apples. e.g., `quant_profile: int8-fastkv`

maria: summary / decisions:
- retry strategy: exponential backoff + jitter, max 3 retries, then mark flaky and alert infra.
- dedupe: fingerprint = model_sha + quant_profile + runtime_flags; dedupe_window = 1h.
- golden policy: per-customer config. Default = sampling-percent 1%. allow override to every-rollout for high-risk orgs. enforce golden_quota for cost control.
- validation errors are terminal (no retries).
- telemetry: include rollout_id, attempt, bench_job.fingerprint, quant_profile, canary_percent.
- cost guardrails: default cost_limit 5$, configurable.

maria: next steps: i'll push a tiny RFC with the contract fields and a runbook for flaky jobs. if no objections by EOD tomorrow i'll open a PR to the intake adapter.

evan: sounds good from infra side.

liz: lgtm, will follow up with golden_quota proposal. :thumbsup:

raj: OK, will draft fingerprint util and unit tests.

maria: thanks all. tagging @eng-ml for FYI and i'll drop the RFC link when it's up.
